column1: # target: Pokémon Legends: Arceus update v262144 trainer parties (bin/trainer/trdata_*.bin)
# note: Party order is the stored vector order; whether it is the send-out order is UNKNOWN.
# note: level (slot 6), nature (slot 7, 0..24), sex (slot 8, 0/1) fill the creation struct next to species/form (LIKELY).
# note: gv_*: slots 9..14; slot 12 is written to the last (speed) entry of the creation struct, so the file order is HP, Atk, Def, Spe, SpA, SpD (LIKELY).
# note: moveN_mastered: move table slot 1 (bool) - LIKELY the move-mastery flag (all moves mastered on late variants).
# note: flag_f15: never set in the data; the code turns it into a rare/shiny mode value (LIKELY shiny flag). flag_f16: set on 3 members; meaning UNKNOWN.
# note: species/move names are development labels from .tools/species_names.json and move_names.json.
